test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 28 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Select the INCORRECT combination of festival and its significance.

options.text: Eid-Milad-ul-Nabi – The birth anniversary of Prophet Muhammad
KarvaChauth – Married women observe a fast from sunrise to moonrise
Kartik Purnima – Marks the birth anniversary of Guru Gobind Singh
Makar Sankranti – Also known as Uttarayana, Lohri, Pongal, Bihu and the Khichdi festival

solution:
The correct answer is __**Kartik Purnima – Marks the birth anniversary of Guru Gobind Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Kartik Purnima, also known as Dev Deepawali, is celebrated on the full moon day of the Hindu lunar month of Kartik.

• It is significant for Hindus, Sikhs, and Jains for various religious reasons.

• For Sikhs, it marks the birth anniversary of Guru Nanak, the founder of Sikhism, not Guru Gobind Singh.

• For Hindus, it is the day when Lord Vishnu incarnated as Matsya (the fish) to save the Vedas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Eid-Milad-ul-Nabi**

• It is celebrated to commemorate the birth anniversary of Prophet Muhammad.

• It is observed on the 12th day of Rabi' al-awwal, the third month in the Islamic calendar.

• **Karva Chauth**

• A one-day festival celebrated by Hindu married women for the well-being and longevity of their husbands.

• Women observe a fast from sunrise to moonrise, without consuming food or water.

• **Makar Sankranti**

• A Hindu festival dedicated to the sun god Surya.

• It marks the transition of the sun into the zodiac sign Capricorn (Makara).

• It is known by different names in different parts of India such as Uttarayana, Lohri, Pongal, Bihu, and the Khichdi festival.
